reviews.name: Gemma L.
reviews.text: Jamie has been absolutely fantastic from start to finish. He came out to quote, designed everything, and completed the fitting. The wardrobes and media wall in our living room look incredible.

reviews.name: Nicola B.
reviews.text: Jamie fitted my bedroom furniture after being let down by another fitter, he advised on the best ways to fit the bedroom to make the most of the space.

reviews.name: Michael M.
reviews.text: Jamie has just completed a full rip-out and re-fit in our Bramhall Cottage. We would thoroughly recommend Jamie Shaw Kitchens to anyone requiring a more local personal approach.
